data.name: Terrence
data.gender_notes: Terrence is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin term ‘terrarius,’ meaning 'man of the land,' or 'terrifying.' In Roman mythology, Terra was the goddess of the Earth, and Terrenus was the Roman term for 'earth.'. The name Terrence carries the meaning “Terrifying, Rock, Mountain” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Terrence usually hope their child will grow to embody terrifying, rock, mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength and a connection to the earth.
data.etymology: Terrence belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Terrifying, Rock, Mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Terrence total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: ‏טרנס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ‏השם טרנס נובע מהמילה הלטינית 'tertius', שמשמעותה היא 'שלישי'. בנוסף, השם קשור לפולחן השלישי, שהייתה דת זרה בעת העתיקה. בזמן הקדם-נוצרי, הפולחן השלישי היה דת פופולרית, והשם טרנס הפך לשם של שלישי ואחר. בברית החדשה, השם טרנס קשור למושג 'טריניטאס', שמשמעותו 'שלישיות'. במונחים נוצריים, השם טרנס מסמל את האמונה בשלישיות האלהים - אבי, בן, ורוח הקודש.

in_greek.name: Τέρενς
in_greek.long_meaning: ‏Ο όνομα Τέρενς προέρχεται από την λατινική λέξη 'tertius', που σημαίνει 'τρίτος'. Στην αρχαία Ρώμη, η λατρεία του τρίτου ήταν μια δημοφιλής θρησκεία. Ο Τέρενς ήταν ένα από τα ονόματα που χρησιμοποιόταν για να περιγράψει το τρίτο άτομο μιας οικογένειας. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Τέρενς συνδέεται με τον ιδέα της τριάς, η οποία αναφέρεται στην τριάδα του Θεού: Πατέρα, Υιό και Πνεύμα. Ο Τέρενς ως όνομα αναφέρεται επίσης στην εικόνα του τρίτου μελλοντικού, του τρίτου ανθρώπου που θα έρθει για να γίνει ο Μεσσία.

in_latin.name: Terrens
in_latin.long_meaning: ‏Nomen Terrens a vocabulo latino tertius, significans tertium, origo habet. In cultu Romano tertius erat deus qui tertium locum habebat. Nomen Terrens ad tertium hominem pertinere solet, tertium locum in familia. In Novo Testamento, nomen Terrens ad idem significat, tertio hominem qui tertium locum habebat.

in_english.name: Terrence
in_english.meaning: ‏name that means third, or one who serves the third
in_english.long_meaning: ‏The name Terrence originates from the Latin word 'tertius', meaning third. In ancient Roman culture, the cult of the third was a popular deity. The name Terrence is often associated with the third person in a family. In Christian tradition, the name Terrence is connected to the concept of the Trinity, which refers to the three persons of God: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. As a given name, Terrence signifies one who serves the third person, often representing the Holy Spirit. In modern times, the name Terrence conveys a sense of spirituality, wisdom, and guidance. It is a popular given name among Christians, symbolizing the trinity and the third person of the Holy Spirit.
